verdict.rationale: Undermind documents an official MCP server (mcp.undermind.ai/mcp) with clear setup instructions for Cursor, VS Code, and Claude, and states it works with any MCP-compatible client, exposing tools like literature review, PDF Q&A, and note management. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that the MCP server itself works reliably (community evidence covers only the web search product, not the MCP integration).
